short: Parallel decoder, learned-feature GAN generator and transformer front end (M06) are standard; 9.14x mel speedup is real, but evaluation (M12) drops the STOI/ESTOI its Lip2Wav baseline reported.
position: FastLTS [@wang2022fastlts] changes the decoding path (M06): a parallel acoustic decoder, a GAN generator on learned features, and a transformer front end. All three are standard: direct waveform generation predates it [@mira2021endtoend], and so does a transformer visual front end for lip reading [@prajwal2021vtp]. The non-autoregressive effect is the 9.14× mel-level speedup; the 19.76× waveform figure the abstract headlines mostly reflects replacing Griffin-Lim, as §5.5 itself notes, and no parallel mel-plus-vocoder system is timed. Evaluation (M12) is standard but narrower than its baseline's protocol: it drops the STOI/ESTOI/PESQ that Lip2Wav reported on the same three speakers [@prajwal2020learning].
